title: Implementation Specialist
description:
Hospitality Implementation Coordinator – Sales & Catering Technology

Location: Brazil — Remote

Employment type: Full-time Contractor

English level: Advanced/Fluent

About the role

We are seeking Hospitality Implementation Coordinators to support the global rollout of a Sales & Catering platform across a large portfolio of hotel properties.

This is a hospitality implementation and project coordination role, not a technical support position. Each coordinator will manage a portfolio of hotels and serve as their primary point of contact throughout the implementation process.

The role is responsible for ensuring that hotel information is collected accurately, implementation activities remain on schedule, required training is completed, and issues are communicated to the appropriate teams. The successful candidate will coordinate closely with hotel properties, regional commercial stakeholders, corporate support teams, external vendors and technical resources.

Hospitality industry experience is the primary requirement. Technical experience is valuable but secondary.

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary implementation contact for assigned hotel properties.
  • Coordinate hotel-level activities for the rollout of a Sales & Catering platform.
  • Guide properties through implementation milestones, readiness requirements and deployment gates.
  • Ensure required hotel data is accurately gathered, mapped, validated and entered into implementation workbooks and systems of record.
  • Follow up on missing information, corrections and data discrepancies.
  • Track implementation progress, critical deadlines and hotel activation status.
  • Identify delays and risks, take appropriate follow-up action and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Verify that required e-learning modules and training activities are completed before hotels advance to the next implementation phase.
  • Follow up with hotels that are behind schedule or have not completed required activities.
  • Coordinate between hotel properties, corporate support teams, regional commercial leads, external vendors and technical resources.
  • Facilitate consultation calls to ensure that platform configurations reflect each hotel’s operational and commercial needs.
  • Validate required participation agreements, billing arrangements and other property-level deployment requirements.
  • Maintain accurate implementation records, dashboards and status reports.
  • Provide regional stakeholders and program leadership with clear updates on implementation progress.
  • Support early-adopter initiatives and encourage hotels to begin implementation ahead of mandatory deadlines.
  • Help ensure consistent communication and execution across multiple implementation workstreams and hotel properties.

Required qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in the travel or hospitality industry.
  • Strong understanding of hotel operations and the impact that technology changes can have on property teams.
  • Experience working in or closely with hotel sales, catering, groups, events or commercial teams.
  • Advanced or fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong project coordination, organization and timeline-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple hotel properties, priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong relationship-building and influencing skills.
  • Ability to motivate stakeholders, reinforce deadlines and follow up consistently without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving implementation risks.
  • Emotional intelligence, self-awareness and cultural sensitivity.
  • Confidence working with spreadsheets, implementation workbooks, dashboards, presentations and project-tracking tools.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote and internationally distributed team.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Delphi, Delphi FDC, Amadeus Sales & Event Management or another hotel Sales & Catering platform.
  • Experience with Property Management Systems (PMS) or other hotel technology implementations.
  • Salesforce experience.
  • Previous involvement in hotel technology rollouts, system migrations, hotel openings or property conversions.
  • Experience supporting implementations across multiple hotel properties or regions.
  • Experience coordinating hotel teams, vendors and technical resources.
  • University degree in hospitality, business, project management or a related field. A degree is preferred but not required.

Ideal candidate

The ideal candidate understands hotel operations and has experience working with hotel sales, catering, groups or events teams. They recognize the operational disruption that a new system can create and can guide hotel teams through change with empathy, organization and accountability.

They are comfortable managing deadlines, following up persistently, maintaining accurate records and communicating with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. They do not need to be a technical specialist, but they should be confident working alongside technical teams and learning hotel technology platforms.

This role does not include

  • Technical product support or software troubleshooting.
  • Software development or system engineering.
  • Product enhancement or feature-request management.
  • Product testing or quality assurance.
  • Ownership of software defects or technical product issues.

title: Cloud FinOps Analyst
description:
Cloud FinOps Analyst (Multi-Cloud & GenAI Infrastructure)

Only CVs in English will be considered

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, highly analytical Cloud FinOps Analyst to establish deep financial visibility, control, and efficiency across our multi-cloud and modern AI infrastructure.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of Engineering, Finance, and Executive Leadership . You will bring rigorous financial discipline and data-driven insights to our infrastructure spend across AWS, GCP, OpenAI, and Anthropic .

We aren't just looking for someone who monitors high-level UI dashboards. We need an analyst who can roll up their sleeves, write complex SQL queries against raw billing data, run quantitative root-cause analyses on spend anomalies, and partner directly with engineering teams to execute technical cost-optimization strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Spend Visibility: Build executive dashboards and granularity reports across AWS, GCP, OpenAI, and Anthropic, tracking key metrics like amortized spend, forecast accuracy, unit costs, and token usage.
  • Structured Anomaly & Variance Root-Cause Analysis: Quantify and investigate budget variances. Methodically isolate drivers by slicing raw billing data by Cloud Provider.
  • Deep Infrastructure Optimization: Partner with DevOps and Engineering to evaluate technical efficiency—moving beyond basic off-hour schedules to rightsizing utilization metrics (vCPU/Memory), storage lifecycle tiering, Spot instances, and container cost allocation (EKS/GKE).
  • Commitment Strategy Management: Evaluate, purchase, and manage commitment-based discounts (AWS Savings Plans/Reserved Instances, GCP CUDs) to maximize discount coverage while maintaining flexibility.
  • GenAI & Token Cost Governance: Track unit economics (cost per prompt/token, custom GPU cluster utilization) and partner with AI engineers to set usage quotas, rate limits, and governance.
  • Cross-Functional Reconciliation: Bridge the gap between Finance and Engineering by reconciling accounting discrepancies (amortization, tax, out-of-cycle charges, billing cycle cutoff dates) using AWS Cost & Usage Reports (CUR) as the single source of truth.

Key Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud FinOps, Cloud Cost Engineering, or Technical Financial Analysis in multi-cloud environments.
  • Hands-On SQL Capability: Proven ability to query billing datasets using aggregations (GROUP BY), window functions (PARTITION BY, dynamic rolling averages), and deduplication logic. (Note: Hands-on SQL is evaluated in our interview process).
  • Cloud & Pricing Mechanics: In-depth technical knowledge of AWS/GCP services and pricing trade-offs between On-Demand, Savings Plans, RIs, and CUDs.
  • Quantitative Problem-Solving: Ability to structure investigation frameworks for unexpected cost spikes rather than relying on high-level theoretical assumptions.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Strong communication skills to clearly articulate engineering trade-offs to Finance, and financial realities to Engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FinOps Certified Practitioner (FCP) or AWS/GCP technical certifications.
  • Hands-on experience tracking spend, token metrics, and custom GPU infrastructure for GenAI platforms ( OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI ).
  • Experience automating billing reconciliation or data pipelines using Python or advanced data modeling.

What We Value

  • Total Ownership: You don't just flag a spend increase—you quantify it, isolate the root cause, propose an engineering fix, and track the realized savings.
  • Technical Depth: You understand the difference between high-level dashboard summaries and underlying resource usage metrics.
  • Bridge Building: You foster a culture of cost accountability and education across engineering teams without hindering innovation or development velocity.

What We Look For

• Strong sense of ownership — takes end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

• Self-motivated and proactive; able to operate independently with minimal supervision.

• A good team player who collaborates effectively across teams, geographies, and time zones.

• Proven track record of delivering measurable results in previous roles.

title: Analista de Supply Chain
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Se você é um profissional de Analista de Supply Chain em busca de uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, esta posição oferece a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, apoiando o planejamento e o acompanhamento da carteira de pedidos de vendas (backlog), garantindo visibilidade sobre a disponibilidade de materiais e contribuindo para o cumprimento dos prazos acordados com os clientes. Você será responsável por realizar análises relacionadas a estoques, abastecimento e atendimento de pedidos, considerando materiais nacionais, importados e itens de produção interna, contribuindo para a excelência operacional e a satisfação dos clientes.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  • Acompanhar e analisar diariamente a carteira de pedidos de vendas (backlog), considerando prioridades, datas solicitadas e compromissos assumidos com os clientes.
  • Avaliar a disponibilidade de produtos acabados, componentes e matérias-primas necessários para o atendimento dos pedidos.
  • Identificar e analisar estratégias de fornecimento para materiais nacionais, importados e de produção interna.
  • Monitorar níveis de estoque, pedidos de compra, ordens de produção, materiais em trânsito e previsões de recebimento.
  • Identificar riscos de atrasos, rupturas de estoque ou indisponibilidade de materiais, comunicando impactos e propondo ações junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Apoiar a definição e atualização das datas previstas de produção, faturamento, entrega e atendimento dos pedidos.
  • Acompanhar o andamento dos pedidos junto às áreas de Compras, Comércio Exterior, PCP, Produção, Qualidade e Logística.
  • Manter informações de planejamento e atendimento atualizadas em sistemas ERP e ferramentas de acompanhamento da área.
  • Apoiar a priorização de ordens de produção e necessidades de abastecimento com base na demanda e nos compromissos assumidos com os clientes.
  • Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento de backlog e Supply Chain, apresentando análises, riscos, pendências e previsões de atendimento.
  • Fornecer informações claras e confiáveis para as áreas de Customer Care e Vendas sobre o andamento dos pedidos.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, incluindo backlog, past due, nível de serviço, cobertura de estoque, disponibilidade de materiais e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Elaborar e atualizar relatórios, dashboards e análises utilizando Excel, Power BI e outras ferramentas de gestão de dados.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, automação de processos e aumento da confiabilidade das informações.
  • Contribuir para a integração do fluxo de informações entre as diferentes áreas da cadeia de suprimentos.

Quem você é:

Você analisa informações de forma estruturada e transforma dados em insights que apoiam decisões e resultados. Comunica-se de maneira clara e eficaz, promovendo alinhamento entre diferentes áreas e construindo relacionamentos colaborativos. Demonstra iniciativa para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e resolver desafios de forma proativa. Mantém foco no cliente e nos objetivos do negócio, equilibrando prioridades operacionais e estratégicas para garantir entregas consistentes e de alta qualidade.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Logística, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior, Gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Microsoft Excel, incluindo fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, filtros e análise de dados.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura, escrita e comunicação em ambiente corporativo.
  • Conhecimento básico ou experiência com sistemas ERP.
  • Noções de gestão de estoques, planejamento de materiais, logística e cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar desvios, interpretar dados e apoiar a tomada de decisões.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Organização e habilidade para gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Facilidade para atuar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas da organização

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Conhecimento dos processos de MRP e planejamento de materiais.
  • Experiência anterior, inclusive estágio, em Supply Chain, Planejamento, Logística, Compras, Comércio Exterior, Customer Care ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Familiaridade com indicadores como backlog, past due, cobertura de estoque, nível de serviço e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Experiência com sistemas ERP em ambiente industrial.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, Power Query ou outras ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados.
  • Noções de processos de importação, produção industrial e abastecimento de materiais.
  • Conhecimento de automação de relatórios e melhoria contínua de processos.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Sobre a WIN SOURCE

WIN SOURCE – Onde o fornecimento começa

Fundada em 1999, a WIN SOURCE ajuda fabricantes a garantir componentes eletrônicos críticos e a construir cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes em um mercado global cada vez mais complexo, com o apoio de uma equipe global de mais de 450 colaboradores.

Por meio da NEXUS™, nossa plataforma inteligente para a cadeia de suprimentos, e de nossa rede mundial de recursos de sourcing, estoque e logística, ajudamos os clientes a tomar decisões de aquisição mais inteligentes, fortalecer a continuidade do fornecimento e responder com confiança aos desafios de um mercado em constante evolução.

Atualmente, a WIN SOURCE atende clientes em todo o mundo por meio de operações estrategicamente localizadas na Ásia, Europa e América do Norte, instalações certificadas e um forte compromisso com a qualidade, a confiabilidade e a excelência operacional.

Sobre a função

A função de Gerente de Vendas Internacionais na WIN SOURCE concentra-se na construção de parcerias estratégicas com OEMs globais, empresas de serviços de manufatura eletrônica (EMS) e empresas de tecnologia, ajudando os clientes a solucionar desafios complexos relacionados ao fornecimento de componentes eletrônicos. Ao atuar com clientes dos setores de infraestrutura de IA, automotivo, industrial, médico e de eletrônicos avançados, o profissional contribui para a continuidade da produção e para programas críticos nos quais o fornecimento confiável de componentes é essencial.

Esta posição desempenha um papel importante no apoio aos clientes na aquisição de componentes, gestão de escassez, mitigação de riscos de fim de vida (EOL), otimização de listas de materiais (BOM) e soluções de continuidade do fornecimento. Isso é feito em colaboração com as equipes globais de sourcing, compras e qualidade da WIN SOURCE, contribuindo para cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes que impulsionam a inovação em diversos setores.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes globais e impulsionar o crescimento sustentável dos negócios nos mercados sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Gerenciar toda a jornada de vendas, desde o desenvolvimento de mercado e o relacionamento com clientes até a gestão de solicitações de cotação (RFQs), negociação e fechamento.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com OEMs, empresas de serviços de manufatura eletrônica (EMS) e equipes de engenharia e compras para oferecer soluções confiáveis para o fornecimento de componentes eletrônicos.
  • Ajudar os clientes a enfrentar desafios na cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo escassez, riscos de fim de vida (EOL), transições de ciclo de vida e otimização de custos.
  • Colaborar com equipes globais e representar a WIN SOURCE em reuniões com clientes e eventos do setor.

Por que fazer parte da WIN SOURCE

Na WIN SOURCE, seu trabalho gera valor que vai além das vendas. Você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Conectar-se com empresas globais de tecnologia e ajudar a garantir os componentes críticos que mantêm as indústrias em operação.
  • Atuar em desafios reais da cadeia de suprimentos nos mercados automotivo, industrial, médico e de eletrônicos avançados.
  • Construir relacionamentos estratégicos com profissionais de engenharia, compras e cadeia de suprimentos em todo o mundo.
  • Utilizar a rede global de sourcing e o conhecimento de mercado da WIN SOURCE para oferecer soluções que vão além da distribuição tradicional.
  • Desenvolver sua carreira em uma organização global, na qual seu trabalho contribui para cadeias de suprimentos mais resilientes e para as tecnologias do futuro.

O que buscamos

  • Ter 3 anos ou mais de experiência em vendas B2B, gestão de contas, desenvolvimento de negócios ou outras funções comerciais relacionadas, com capacidade comprovada de desenvolver clientes e impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios.
  • Experiência em componentes eletrônicos, semicondutores, distribuição de componentes eletrônicos, EMS ou cadeias de suprimentos da indústria de manufatura é altamente desejável.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e construção de relacionamentos, com capacidade para compreender as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções orientadas à geração de valor.
  • Mentalidade focada no cliente, forte visão comercial e capacidade de gerenciar oportunidades ao longo de todo o ciclo de vendas.
  • Paixão por vendas internacionais e desenvolvimento de negócios, com atitude proativa, forte senso de responsabilidade e motivação para criar valor de longo prazo em um ambiente global.

Benefícios e crescimento profissional

Na WIN SOURCE, reconhecemos e recompensamos as pessoas que geram impacto.

Oferecemos:

  • Salário-base competitivo e estrutura de comissões sem limite, permitindo que profissionais de alto desempenho maximizem seu potencial de ganhos.
  • Oportunidades de vendas globais com clientes internacionais, contas estratégicas e exposição aos mercados mundiais de eletrônicos.
  • A oportunidade de atuar no centro da cadeia global de suprimentos de eletrônicos, ajudando fabricantes a garantir componentes críticos e solucionar desafios reais de negócios.
  • Treinamento profissional, desenvolvimento de conhecimento do setor e um plano de carreira claro rumo à liderança comercial.
  • Oportunidades de participar de mais de 50 feiras internacionais, reuniões com clientes e atividades comerciais globais.
  • Um ambiente multicultural e colaborativo, com equipes na Ásia, Europa e América do Norte.
  • Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira: Gerente de Vendas → Gerente Regional de Vendas → Gerente Regional Sênior de Vendas → Liderança Global de Vendas

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.

Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.

Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.

What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.

Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.

Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Arquiteto de dados
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting está com uma oportunidade imediata para Arquiteto(a) de Dados GCP experiente, com forte conhecimento técnico e verdadeira paixão por resolução de problemas complexos através da tecnologia. O profissional fará parte de um projeto estratégico com foco na revisão e otimização da arquitetura de dados em Google Cloud Platform, buscando aumento de eficiência, escalabilidade, governança e redução significativa dos custos de processamento em BigQuery.

Buscamos um perfil sênior, consultivo e hands-on, capaz de atuar desde a definição e revisão da arquitetura até a implementação das melhorias necessárias no ambiente.

Perfil técnico:

  • Sólida experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e BigQuery , atuando em ambientes corporativos de dados de grande volume;
  • Experiência em arquitetura, otimização e sustentação de plataformas de dados em cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado de arquitetura de Data Lake, incluindo organização e otimização das camadas Raw, Sub-Raw, Silver, Gold e Platinum;
  • Experiência no desenho de estratégias de processamento incremental, evitando reprocessamentos e leituras desnecessárias de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento avançado de otimização de tabelas no BigQuery, incluindo particionamento, clustering, cargas incrementais e otimização de queries;
  • Experiência em análise de performance e custos de processamento no BigQuery;
  • Conhecimento de estratégias para tratamento e processamento de tabelas SAP de grande volume;
  • Experiência com integração e ingestão de dados provenientes de ambientes como SAP e Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas e tecnologias de integração como Airbyte, Apache Airflow, DAGs e CDC – Change Data Capture;
  • Capacidade de revisar pipelines de ingestão e processamento de dados, identificando oportunidades de melhoria de performance e redução de custos;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de dados transacional e analítica, incluindo definição adequada de workloads para cada tipo de processamento;
  • Capacidade de avaliar alternativas tecnológicas, incluindo utilização de bancos como PostgreSQL para workloads transacionais e atualizações operacionais frequentes;
  • Experiência com práticas de FinOps aplicadas a dados e cloud, incluindo análise de baseline de consumo, monitoramento de custos e identificação de oportunidades de otimização;
  • Capacidade de estruturar mecanismos de acompanhamento da economia obtida através das otimizações implementadas;
  • Conhecimento de modelos de alocação e visibilidade de custos por área, domínio, projeto ou unidade de negócio;
  • Experiência com governança de ambientes BigQuery, incluindo organização de projetos por domínio ou área de negócio;
  • Conhecimento de IAM, permissões, grupos de acesso e estratégias de consumo cross-project dentro do GCP;
  • Capacidade de analisar criticamente decisões arquiteturais existentes e propor alternativas tecnicamente sustentáveis e economicamente eficientes;
  • Experiência prática em troubleshooting, produção e sustentação de ambientes de dados críticos;
  • Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de implementar diretamente soluções e otimizações propostas.

Atuação:

  • Atuar na revisão da arquitetura atual de dados em GCP e BigQuery, identificando oportunidades de redução de processamento e consumo;
  • Estabelecer baseline técnico e financeiro do ambiente atual para acompanhamento dos ganhos obtidos;
  • Trabalhar com meta indicativa de redução entre 50% e 60% dos custos de processamento, condicionada às oportunidades identificadas durante a análise técnica do ambiente;
  • Revisar arquitetura, modelagem, pipelines, tabelas, queries e estratégias de processamento atualmente utilizadas;
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de processamento incremental e otimização das diferentes camadas do Data Lake;
  • Revisar workloads transacionais e analíticos, recomendando a arquitetura mais adequada para cada cenário;
  • Apoiar a evolução da governança do BigQuery, incluindo estrutura de projetos, domínios, permissões e consumo entre projetos;
  • Estruturar indicadores para acompanhamento de consumo, performance e economia gerada pelas iniciativas de otimização;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às equipes técnicas, questionando decisões arquiteturais e propondo soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas de arquitetura, performance e FinOps;
  • Participar diretamente da implementação, validação, produção e sustentação das melhorias propostas;
  • Atuação em projeto estratégico de otimização e evolução de plataforma de dados em ambiente corporativo de grande escala.

Other

  • English – Advanced (Diferencial)
  • Google Cloud Certifications (Diferencial)

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Project Manager
description:
The project is part of a next-generation SaaS technology platform operating in the transportation and supply chain logistics domain. The company behind the platform has decades of industry experience and is recognized as an employer of choice, with a strong culture of innovation and technical excellence.

The platform delivers a suite of data-driven software solutions used daily by millions of customers who rely on accurate, real-time insights to make informed business decisions and improve profitability. At its core, the system supports one of the largest digital marketplaces in its industry , processing hundreds of millions of transactions annually and maintaining a massive database representing hundreds of billions of dollars in global market activity.

The technology stack is built to handle extreme scale , high availability, and data accuracy, enabling customers to operate efficiently in a fast-moving, competitive environment. Engineering teams work on highly distributed systems, advanced data processing pipelines, and analytics-driven services that continuously evolve to meet growing market demands.

Responsibilities

Team Management & People Development

  • Manage and support the engineering team ±20 people in LATAM (incl. but not only Brazil) through regular 1:1 meetings.
  • Build strong relationships with team members and maintain a healthy and productive team environment.
  • Support engineers in their professional development and career growth.
  • Monitor individual and team performance and provide regular feedback.
  • Identify performance issues early and create improvement plans when necessary.
  • Support employee engagement, motivation, and retention.
  • Handle and help resolve conflicts within the team.

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Manage the onboarding of new team members and ensure smooth integration into the company and client teams.
  • Support engineers during their first months on the project and monitor their adaptation and performance.
  • Manage the offboarding process and coordinate communication with internal teams and client stakeholders when required.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Manage the recruitment process for new engineers in cooperation with the Recruitment team.
  • Clarify position requirements, seniority, technical expectations, and team needs.
  • Participate in candidate evaluation and final hiring decisions.
  • Monitor staffing progress and proactively address hiring challenges.
  • Support workforce planning and identify future staffing needs.

Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders.
  • Understand client expectations, priorities, concerns, and business needs.
  • Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and provide visibility into team performance, staffing, risks, and delivery-related topics.
  • Manage client expectations and proactively address potential issues.
  • Handle difficult conversations and conflicts between the client, engineers, and the company.
  • Represent the company's interests while maintaining a strong and trusted relationship with the client.
  • Escalate risks and critical issues appropriately and work with both sides toward mutually acceptable solutions.

Business Development & Account Growth

  • Understand the client's organization, business objectives, and future plans.
  • Identify opportunities to expand cooperation with existing clients.
  • Recognize potential needs for additional engineers, teams, or services and communicate opportunities internally.
  • Participate in discussions related to new roles, team extensions, and new areas of cooperation.
  • Build relationships with additional stakeholders within the client organization.
  • Support account growth by maintaining high client satisfaction and identifying opportunities for further partnership.
  • Work closely with Delivery, Sales, Recruitment, and other internal teams on account development.

Operational Management

  • Monitor team allocation, staffing changes, performance risks, and retention risks.
  • Coordinate internal processes related to employees working on client accounts.
  • Ensure important information is communicated between the client, engineers, and internal company stakeholders.
  • Identify operational risks and proactively propose solutions.
  • Support planning related to team structure, replacements, transfers, and future growth.

Skills & Experience Required

Management Experience

  • Experience managing software engineering teams.
  • Strong people-management and coaching skills.
  • Experience conducting 1:1s, performance reviews, development discussions, and difficult conversations.
  • Ability to identify performance and motivation issues and take appropriate action.
  • Strong conflict-management and problem-solving skills.

Outsourcing / IT Services Experience

  • Previous experience working in an IT outsourcing, consulting, nearshore, or software services company is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of the relationship between the client, outsourcing company, and engineers assigned to the client project .
  • Experience balancing client expectations with company and employee interests.
  • Understanding of common outsourcing challenges, including staffing, retention, performance management, replacements, rate discussions, and client satisfaction.
  • Ability to act as a trusted intermediary when disagreements or conflicts arise between the client and the company.

Stakeholder Management

  • Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with international clients and distributed teams.
  • Ability to manage expectations, negotiate priorities, and handle sensitive situations professionally.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.

Business Development

  • Commercial mindset and interest in developing existing client accounts.
  • Ability to recognize new business and team-growth opportunities.
  • Ability to understand client business needs beyond the immediate engineering scope.
  • Experience participating in account-growth, staffing, or client-development discussions is preferred.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships that can lead to long-term cooperation and account expansion.

Recruitment & Staffing

  • Understanding of the software engineering recruitment process.
  • Ability to define hiring needs together with technical and client stakeholders.
  • Experience interviewing or evaluating candidates is preferred.
  • Understanding of the Brazilian engineering talent market is an advantage.

Communication & Personal Skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong ownership and proactive mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and make decisions.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to manage several people-related, client-related, and operational topics simultaneously.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively in challenging or sensitive situations.
  • Ability to communicate bad news, risks, or disagreements clearly and constructively.

Language & International Environment

  • Strong professional English is required for communication with international clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience working in multicultural and distributed environments is preferred.

description:
Position: Production Technician Trainee

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 57 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.

Job Purpose

Execute routine inspections and predictive/preventive maintenance activities on topside systems and equipment, ensuring safe and reliable operations in accordance with company procedures, permit-to-work requirements, and supervisor instructions.

Responsibilities

Perform routine rounds throughout the process plant to monitor system and equipment performance and report abnormal conditions.

Execute first-line maintenance on process systems and equipment in accordance with CMMS work orders, daily inspections, and supervisor instructions.

Conduct line walks to verify proper system isolations before Permit to Work (PTW) release.

Prepare systems and equipment for maintenance activities, including draining, cleaning, and purging prior to handover.

Perform preservation activities, visual inspections, vibration, temperature and noise checks, oil changes and top-ups, cleaning of filters, strainers, drains, and sight glasses, gasket replacement (when specific competency is not required), and paint touch-ups.

Ensure all activities are carried out in compliance with company procedures, SOPs, and safety requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, Chemical, or related Engineering fields, from a recognized educational institution.
  • Recent graduate with up to 2 years of graduation.
  • Basic knowledge of industrial operations, maintenance, process systems, or equipment inspection gained through academic studies, internships, or practical training.
  • Willingness to learn and develop technical skills in offshore operations, first-line maintenance, equipment inspections, and Permit to Work (PTW) procedures.
  • English: Intermediate (mandatory for Brazilian candidates).

Life Insurance.

Private Pension Plan.

title: Senior 3D Artist Generalist
description:
About the Company

Enver is a leading VR game studio and publisher headquartered in New York City. We build viral, social gaming worlds and are known for top-tier publishing and marketing, with creator-led campaigns behind some of the biggest titles in VR, including chart-topping games on Meta Quest. Our specialty is social, live-ops driven multiplayer games built around communities, creators, and content loops.

About the Role

A free to play, social VR game for Meta Quest. You are the senior artist on a small team and the go-to for everything visual. Your core responsibility is making art: environments, characters, props, effects and UI, from concept to optimized, in-engine assets. Alongside that you help define the art direction, plan the art schedule, and distribute tasks across the other artists. Management responsibilities are light. Most of your week is spent building.

The cycle is fast. Ideas become playable prototypes in weeks, with a custom character and a custom environment in that window, and games that go forward move into live ops with new content every few weeks. What you make reaches real players quickly, and you see the reaction the same week.

Responsibilities

  • Model, texture and ship game-ready 3D assets: environments, characters, props and world dressing
  • Build VR environments that are fun to move through and easy to read, with clear landmarks and good visibility between players
  • Create VFX using VFX Graph or Particle System
  • Build UI and in-world interactive pieces that work well in VR
  • Set up assets in Unity: materials, prefabs, lighting, LODs and collision, ready for developers to use
  • Optimize for Meta Quest: draw calls, texture atlases, poly budgets, lighting and shader cost
  • Help define the art style and keep it consistent across the game
  • Plan the art schedule with the PM, distribute tasks across the artists, and keep the project board accurate
  • Keep shipping new content for live ops after launch: cosmetics, maps, seasonal items
  • Collaborate daily with design, engineering and production in a fully remote team

Qualifications

  • 3+ years as a 3D artist or generalist in games, with at least one shipped title supported post-launch
  • Shipped VR or mobile work with tight performance budgets, ideally Meta Quest
  • Strong across the full 3D pipeline: high and low poly modeling, UVs, baking, texturing, and Unity integration
  • Environment art: set dressing, props, terrain and lighting
  • Character art: stylized characters, skins and cosmetics that read well in VR
  • Rigging: skeletons, skinning and weight painting for characters and props
  • Animation: keyframe and looping animations for characters, props and UI, set up in Unity's Animator
  • VFX: VFX Graph or Particle System, plus simple shader work in Shader Graph
  • Materials and shaders: PBR and stylized workflows, texture atlases, material setup in URP
  • Optimization for Meta Quest: poly and texture budgets, draw calls, LODs, lightmaps and baked lighting
  • Stylized, vibrant, readable art. Simple shapes and bold colors that appeal to a young audience
  • Comfortable in Blender or Maya, Substance Painter, and Unity (URP)
  • Excellent communication: you share work early, take feedback well, and thrive in an async remote environment

Bonus Skills

  • Concept art or illustration
  • Marketing art: store screenshots, trailers, key art, creator assets
  • Understanding of the VR market

Pay range and compensation package

$1,500 to $3,500 USD per month

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices.

title: Learning Support Teacher
description:
Job Overview: 

The Learning Support Teacher plays a crucial, integral role in ensuring high-quality learning support for students, serving as a key advocate and model for inclusive and equitable approaches to education. This position requires a commitment to understanding and addressing the unique learning profiles of every student, working in direct partnership with teachers and staff to foster an environment where all students can thrive. The Learning Support Teacher reports to the Principal, while receiving specialized technical guidance, instruction, and collaborative supervision from the Student Services Coordinator, always serving the best educational interests of the School and its students.

Core Responsibilities:

Student Support & Intervention

  • Work in collaboration with teachers to design and provide support for students identified as requiring support.
  • Responsible for creating, updating, and implementing Student Support Plans (SSP) and Individual Education Plans (IEP), alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Collaborate and update Student Observation and Action Plan (SOAP) as the internal documentation of identified needs and strategies.
  • Attend SOAP meetings, to contribute with insights and observations of referred students collaborating with the action plan and strategies moving forward.
  • Provide individual and small-group support to identified students. This includes academic, social, emotional, behavioral support through creating opportunities.
  • Assist students in developing organizational, self-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Attend grade-level planning meetings to design and advocate for accessible learning.
  • Participate in learning support team meetings to contribute with the reflection and improvement of best practice, housekeeping and guidelines are services offered.
  • Implement accommodations, modifications, and adaptations to the learning environment or learning experiences (curriculum, assignments, and assessments) in collaboration with teachers and in accordance with students’ plans.
  • Build strong, supportive relationships with families and students to encourage student success.
  • Communicate regularly with parents/guardians regarding student progress, concerns, and intervention strategies.
  • Participate in family meetings, conferences, and reviews of support plans.
  • Provide support to enable students with learning differences to access the curriculum and show understanding.
  • Support the development and maintenance of EAC’s Student Services and Learning Support policies and approaches, particularly in relation to students with unique learning profiles.
  • Oversee grade checks, missing work reports, and academic risk monitoring, as required.
  • Maintain documentation of intervention and support sessions. Add and update Child Study Team Meeting documents with notes when communicating with the family.
  • Track student progress using school data systems and report trends or concerns to administration.
  • Co-lead Child Study Team Meetings (ES) / SSP/IEP Meetings (US) alongside the Student Services Coordinator.
  • Assess and facilitate the implementation of accommodations requirements for students during assessments.
  • Provide feedback and encouragement to parents, with respect to how they can support their children.
  • Identify and implement/supervise accommodations and modifications to the regular curriculum for students with specific needs.
  • Work with the Student Services Coordinator to keep accurate records of student achievement and provide suitable communication and reports to parents and teachers.
  • Promote practices based on sound educational research (ensuring evidence‐based practices are implemented).
  • Attend professional development opportunities or training as appropriate, with the aim of maintaining currency of teacher registration and professional knowledge.

Collaboration

  • Liaise with the various external professionals, teachers, and families to focus on the needs of individual students, with the purpose of facilitating appropriate learning support or enrichment/extension.
  • Partner with teachers to implement classroom accommodations, modifications, and behavior supports.
  • Monitor students’ progress and well-being.
  • Provide professional development and resources to Teachers serving diverse learners.
  • Develop positive working partnerships with students, families, and staff to support, improve, and extend students’ learning.
  • Interact empathetically with children and their families, showing concern for the well-being and learning of all children.
  • Participate actively in Grade-Level Meetings providing additional information about students with plans and suggestions for strategies to support students and improve teaching and learning.
  • Help develop, monitor, and review behavior plans for students with recurring challenges on the case load.
  • Support teachers with classroom management strategies as needed.
  • Coordinate interventions such as homework clubs, study halls, or academic support blocks.

Operational and Professional Conduct

  • Uphold professional standards by adhering to EAC Teacher Handbook procedures and assisting in enforcing school policies.
  • Communicate effectively with parents, students, and staff regarding student progress.
  • Maintain accurate student records.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to share ideas, materials, and methods.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities.
  • Actively engage in school life and perform assigned supervisory duties, when assigned.
  • Promptly report maintenance concerns and order necessary supplies following school guidelines.
  • Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide .

Other duties, as assigned.

Working Conditions:

  • Walk on paths and rough terrain
  • May include lifting educational structures and materials for class set up

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education Required:  

BA or Specialization in Special Education. Neuropsychology, psychopedagogy or equivalent

Minimum Experience Required:

  • Five years of teaching experience, preferred
  • Experience working with learners with learning and/or developmental differences.
  • Experience working in a school setting or educational environment.

Specific Knowledge:

  • Neurodiversity and best practices in education for diverse learners.
  • Whole child student-centered and solution-oriented.
  • Committed to the development of the professional self in accordance with EAC’s Teacher Standards.

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Approachable, with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to manage difficult situations, be learner focused and data driven.
  • Collegial and collaborative.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Organized, adaptable and able to work well under pressure.

English level required:

C1 or above

Portuguese level required:

none for teachers instructing in English

C1 or above for teachers instructing in Portuguese

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Revenue Accountant
description:
US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.

You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.

What You Will Own

  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing
  • Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment
  • Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables
  • Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar
  • Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause
  • Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances
  • Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number
  • Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements
  • Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution
  • Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas
  • Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and RevOps on deal structuring and billing questions
  • Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle

What We're Looking For

  • 4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting
  • Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion
  • Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements
  • Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause
  • Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, or equivalent)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant
  • Availability for US time zone overlap

Preferred

  • SaaS, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics
  • Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or NetSuite ARM
  • CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience
  • Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company
  • Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit

Why Join MAVI?

  • Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first
  • Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer
  • Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies
  • Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders
  • Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles
  • Flexible remote-first work culture
  • Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

title: Analista Pleno de Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A)
description:

Você fará parte de uma cultura colaborativa, solidária e respeitosa, onde valorizamos a diversidade e a singularidade de cada pessoa, reconhecendo que diferentes visões ampliam nossa capacidade de inovar e gerar impacto. Todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas, independentemente de identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, religião, idade ou deficiência. Nosso compromisso é garantir processos justos e um ambiente inclusivo, onde talento e protagonismo sejam os verdadeiros critérios de crescimento.

Nome do Cargo: Analista Pleno de Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A)

Local: Vila Olímpia, SP - Híbrido 3x2

Reporta-se para: Coordenador de Planejamento Financeiro

Como Analista Pleno de Planejamento Financeiro (FP&A), você será responsável por conduzir o planejamento e as análises financeiras (budget, forecast e fechamento), garantindo a consolidação e qualidade das informações. Atuará na análise de margens, preço/volume/mix e na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais, apoiando a tomada de decisão e interagindo com diferentes áreas do negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar a execução do fechamento gerencial mensal.
  • Consolidar e validar informações de P&L, Balanço Patrimonial e Fluxo de Caixa.
  • Preparar relatórios gerenciais e materiais para Diretoria, CFO, Corporate e comitês.
  • Apoiar os processos de forecast, estimativas e budget.
  • Consolidar informações das áreas e unidades de negócio, realizando cargas, validações e conciliações nos sistemas corporativos.
  • Analisar variações de Actual vs. Budget vs. Forecast vs. Prior Year e investigar divergências antes do reporte.
  • Atualizar modelos financeiros, bases de dados, relatórios, apresentações e dashboards em Power BI.
  • Garantir organização, integridade, rastreabilidade e documentação das informações financeiras.
  • Acompanhar o calendário de fechamento, forecast e budget, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação, simplificação e melhoria dos processos de reporting.
  • Preparar análises para apoiar o Coordenador de FP&A e as áreas de negócio.
  • Traduzir variações financeiras, riscos e oportunidades em explicações objetivas e apoiar a validação de premissas e planos de ação.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência em FP&A, Reporting ou áreas relacionadas
  • Conhecimento das principais demonstrações financeiras
  • Experiência com fechamento gerencial, consolidação de informações ou análise de variações
  • Excel avançado e conhecimento de Power BI
  • Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com prazos recorrentes
  • Inglês avançado

Diferenciais

  • Experiência anterior em Auditoria, Contabilidade ou Controladoria
  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis e conhecimento de controles internos e processos contábeis

title: 3D Character Animator
description:
3D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter

I'm looking to hire an experienced 3D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life.

The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay.

What I'm Looking For

Required

  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3D character animation
  • Ideally 5–10+ years of 3D animation experience
  • Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects
  • Excellent understanding of:
  • Combat animation
  • Body mechanics
  • Weight and momentum
  • Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact
  • Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes
  • Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves
  • Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay
  • Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game

Strongly Preferred

  • Cascadeur
  • Blender
  • Unity
  • Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity
Bonus Skills

I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3D character pipeline , including:

  • Retopology (for minor clean-up work)
  • UV unwrapping
  • Texturing
  • Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)
  • Weight painting
  • Character and animal animation
  • Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity
  • Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings

These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority . If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you.

The Project

This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone.

Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

I'm looking for someone who:

  • Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying
  • Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation
  • Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly
  • Has experience with small or independent game-development teams
  • Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement
  • If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

title: Segment Manager
description:
Position Details

Job Title: Segment Sales Manager — Short Range

Product Focus: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE & Short-Range Connectivity

Department: Sales — Latin America

Function: Segment Sales / Business Development

Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM

Region: Latin America (LATAM)

Location: Brazil — supporting the LATAM region

Work Arrangement: (Hybrid / Remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Objective

Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for Short Range products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating Wi-Fi/Bluetooth design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand Short Range penetration within the existing customer base.

Primary Responsibilities

Market Growth & New Business

  • Own LATAM growth for Quectel Short Range products, with dedicated focus on customer acquisition, new verticals and market-share expansion.
  • Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value and design-win potential.
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to add Short Range solutions to active accounts.
  • Develop account strategies for customers designing connected products that require Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE or other short-range wireless connectivity.

Customer & Design-Win Development

  • Understand customer applications, connectivity architecture, product requirements, qualification process and commercial expectations, and position the most relevant Short Range solution.
  • Track samples, technical evaluations, platform discussions, qualifications and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel.
  • Initiate and schedule roadmap meetings to identify future products and position Quectel early in the customer design cycle.
  • Maintain strong follow-up from first engagement through technical validation, commercial negotiation and conversion.

Sales Enablement & Channel Development

  • Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms and distributors on the Short Range portfolio, target applications, competitive positioning and sales messages.
  • Support local sales teams with account strategy, opportunity qualification and customer-facing positioning for Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity solutions.
  • Share use cases, competitive intelligence and market insights that help the wider sales organization recognize and win Short Range opportunities.

Product & Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, roadmap needs, feature gaps and competitive positioning.
  • Translate customer and market feedback into actionable input for product planning, technical support and commercial strategy.
  • Coordinate internal resources to advance strategic Short Range opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.

CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity and activity information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, customer meetings, roadmap discussions, risks and next steps.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals and major customer programs relevant to Wi-Fi/Bluetooth and short-range connectivity growth.
  • Attend trade shows and industry events to identify connected products, target accounts and new Short Range opportunities, and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.

Qualifications & Experience

What we are looking for

  • (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2B technical sales, business development or segment sales within Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, wireless modules/chipsets, semiconductors, IoT hardware or a closely related field.
  • Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue.
  • Working understanding of embedded connectivity products, customer design cycles and the commercial/technical collaboration required to win component or module business.
  • Comfort discussing Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE and short-range connectivity use cases with customers and internal technical teams.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills across a multi-country sales region.
  • Hands-on CRM discipline and ability to produce clear funnel, activity and business-review reporting.
  • Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English.
  • Ability and willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development and industry events.

Preferred background

  • Experience selling Wi-Fi/Bluetooth modules, wireless chipsets, embedded connectivity solutions, IoT modules or related semiconductor products.
  • Existing relationships within LATAM IoT, industrial, smart-home, gateway/router, POS, consumer-device or other connected-product ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting distributors, representative firms or channel partners.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product Management, FAE and engineering teams on technical evaluations, platform requirements and customer design-ins.

What Success Looks Like

  • Growth in qualified Short Range pipeline and new target accounts.
  • Increase in Wi-Fi/Bluetooth design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions.
  • Higher Short Range penetration across existing Quectel accounts.
  • Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through.
  • Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting.
  • Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.

Key Working Relationships

  • Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), local sales teams, representative firms and distributors.
  • Product Management, Technical/FAE teams and other internal stakeholders supporting customer design wins.
  • Customers, prospects, ecosystem partners and industry contacts across LATAM.

About Quectel

Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate IoT innovation. We are an end-to-end global IoT solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our Short Range business combines a broad Wi-Fi and Bluetooth/BLE module portfolio with regional technical support, certification services, and design-in assistance.

Industries & Applications

Quectel’s Short Range portfolio powers connected products across:

  • Smart home and consumer devices
  • Gateways, routers, and CPE
  • Point of sale and retail terminals
  • Industrial IoT and automation
  • Smart metering and utilities
  • Asset tracking and telematics
  • Healthcare and wearable devices

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and embedded connectivity solutions in mission-critical applications.
  • Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with IoT experts across engineering, sales, and operations.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market
  • Uncapped sales commission tied to Short Range revenue and design wins in your territory
  • Meal and grocery vouchers
  • Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents
  • Dental coverage

  • Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law
  • International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization

Learn More

Explore products, careers, and news at , or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on LinkedIn.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.
