Prestar assistência domiciliar com ética, responsabilidade e humanização. Auxiliar nas atividades de vida diária, como higiene, alimentação, mobilidade, medicações (quando autorizadas) e conforto, respeitando a autonomia e as necessidades de cada paciente. Estimular a autonomia, a interação social e o bem-estar do paciente, incentivando atividades compatíveis com sua condição clínica, como conversas, jogos, leituras, caminhadas, passeios e outras atividades que favoreçam sua qualidade de vida, sempre que possível. Oferecer companhia, acolhimento e suporte emocional, promovendo um ambiente seguro, respeitoso e acolhedor. Observar alterações no estado geral do paciente e comunicar prontamente à família e/ou à equipe responsável. Zelar pela organização, limpeza e higiene do ambiente utilizado pelo paciente, contribuindo para seu conforto e segurança. Auxiliar no preparo de refeições simples destinadas ao paciente, quando essa atividade fizer parte da rotina estabelecida pela família e estiver relacionada aos cuidados prestados. Acompanhar o paciente em consultas, exames, atividades externas e compromissos, quando solicitado. Cumprir as orientações da equipe técnica e da família, mantendo postura profissional, ética, sigilo e respeito em todos os atendimentos. Registrar informações relevantes sobre a assistência prestada, por meio do aplicativo da empresa ou do caderno de ocorrências, conforme protocolo estabelecido.

Áreas de atuação

Estamos recrutando profissionais para atuar conforme a demanda em:

Assistência a idosos. Pessoas com deficiência. Recuperação pós-operatória. Cuidados paliativos. Recuperação clínica. Acompanhamento hospitalar. Cuidados infantis. Acompanhamento personalizado em consultas, exames, viagens e atividades externas.

Qualificações

Curso de Cuidador de Idosos. Experiência na função será considerada um diferencial. Curso de Primeiros Socorros e Emergências Clínicas será considerado um diferencial. Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal. Comprometimento, ética, responsabilidade e pontualidade. Empatia, paciência e respeito à individualidade de cada paciente. Disponibilidade para atuar em diferentes escalas e para viagens, quando necessário.

O que buscamos:

Na Bettini Auri Vita, acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de respeito, empatia e dedicação. Procuramos profissionais que enxerguem cada paciente como um ser único, valorizando sua história, sua autonomia e sua dignidade.

Mais do que experiência, buscamos pessoas comprometidas em oferecer um cuidado acolhedor, humano e responsável, construindo relações de confiança com os pacientes, suas famílias e nossa equipe.

Se você acredita que pequenas atitudes podem transformar o dia de alguém e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa que cresce com propósito, carinho e responsabilidade, será uma alegria conhecer você.

title: Administrative specialist - events and facilities
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

About the Role

We are seeking an Administrative Specialist to support the management of administrative and facilities-related operations, ensuring efficient service delivery, effective vendor management, cost control, and a high-quality employee experience.

This role will act as an important operational partner for internal teams, coordinating administrative demands, supporting corporate events, managing vendor relationships, and monitoring budgets and service performance.

The professional will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to optimize processes, improve service quality, and increase operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Vendor Management

Support the management of the Administrative and Facilities vendor portfolio , including cleaning, transportation, catering, maintenance, accommodation, and corporate events. Conduct quotations, analyze and compare proposals, and support contract negotiations to achieve the best cost-benefit relationship. Monitor vendor SLAs, quality standards, and performance indicators , identifying deviations and supporting corrective actions when necessary. Support contract renewals and renegotiations in partnership with the relevant subject-matter experts. Maintain effective relationships with vendors and ensure alignment with company standards, operational requirements, and service expectations.

Internal Events

Support the planning and execution of internal company events, including onboarding programs, celebrations, training sessions, workshops, and other corporate initiatives . Coordinate event logistics, including venues, catering, equipment, communications, and supporting vendors. Manage event budgets, timelines, and operational requirements, ensuring activities are delivered according to plan. Prepare supporting materials for events, including visual assets, communications, and operational documents . Collect and analyze participant feedback and identify opportunities to continuously improve the employee experience.

Budget and Cost Management

Monitor monthly and annual budgets for the areas under management, in partnership with the respective specialists. Track expenses and identify opportunities for cost reduction, resource optimization, and process efficiency . Support the preparation of dashboards, reports, and management presentations to provide visibility into operational performance and costs. Ensure administrative activities are aligned with approved budgets and financial guidelines.

Operational Support

Act as a key point of contact for internal client areas, understanding their needs and coordinating appropriate solutions. Support continuous improvement projects within Facilities and Administrative Operations . Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including HR, Finance, Labor Relations, Procurement, EHS, and other business areas , to ensure smooth execution of administrative initiatives. Identify operational gaps and proactively propose solutions to improve service quality, efficiency, and employee experience. Support the implementation and standardization of administrative processes and operational controls.

Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Facilities Management, Engineering, Hospitality Management , or a related field. Previous experience in Facilities, Administrative Operations, Workplace Management, Vendor Management , or related areas. Experience managing vendors, conducting quotations, supporting negotiations, and monitoring service performance. Experience with budget tracking, cost control, and operational reporting . Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with internal stakeholders, vendors, and employees at different organizational levels . Advanced English proficiency in written and spoken communication is required, due to frequent interaction with expatriates and international stakeholders. Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Power Point .

title: Project manager
description:
The project is part of a next-generation Saa S technology platform operating in the transportation and supply chain logistics domain. The company behind the platform has decades of industry experience and is recognized as an employer of choice, with a strong culture of innovation and technical excellence.

The platform delivers a suite of data-driven software solutions used daily by millions of customers who rely on accurate, real-time insights to make informed business decisions and improve profitability. At its core, the system supports one of the largest digital marketplaces in its industry , processing hundreds of millions of transactions annually and maintaining a massive database representing hundreds of billions of dollars in global market activity.

The technology stack is built to handle extreme scale , high availability, and data accuracy, enabling customers to operate efficiently in a fast-moving, competitive environment. Engineering teams work on highly distributed systems, advanced data processing pipelines, and analytics-driven services that continuously evolve to meet growing market demands.

Responsibilities

Team Management & People Development Manage and support the engineering team ±20 people in LATAM (incl. but not only Brazil) through regular 1:1 meetings. Build strong relationships with team members and maintain a healthy and productive team environment. Support engineers in their professional development and career growth. Monitor individual and team performance and provide regular feedback. Identify performance issues early and create improvement plans when necessary. Support employee engagement, motivation, and retention. Handle and help resolve conflicts within the team.

Onboarding & Offboarding Manage the onboarding of new team members and ensure smooth integration into the company and client teams. Support engineers during their first months on the project and monitor their adaptation and performance. Manage the offboarding process and coordinate communication with internal teams and client stakeholders when required.

Recruitment & Staffing Manage the recruitment process for new engineers in cooperation with the Recruitment team. Clarify position requirements, seniority, technical expectations, and team needs. Participate in candidate evaluation and final hiring decisions. Monitor staffing progress and proactively address hiring challenges. Support workforce planning and identify future staffing needs.

Stakeholder & Client Management Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders. Understand client expectations, priorities, concerns, and business needs. Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and provide visibility into team performance, staffing, risks, and delivery-related topics. Manage client expectations and proactively address potential issues. Handle difficult conversations and conflicts between the client, engineers, and the company. Represent the company's interests while maintaining a strong and trusted relationship with the client. Escalate risks and critical issues appropriately and work with both sides toward mutually acceptable solutions.

Business Development & Account Growth Understand the client's organization, business objectives, and future plans. Identify opportunities to expand cooperation with existing clients. Recognize potential needs for additional engineers, teams, or services and communicate opportunities internally. Participate in discussions related to new roles, team extensions, and new areas of cooperation. Build relationships with additional stakeholders within the client organization. Support account growth by maintaining high client satisfaction and identifying opportunities for further partnership. Work closely with Delivery, Sales, Recruitment, and other internal teams on account development.

Operational Management Monitor team allocation, staffing changes, performance risks, and retention risks. Coordinate internal processes related to employees working on client accounts. Ensure important information is communicated between the client, engineers, and internal company stakeholders. Identify operational risks and proactively propose solutions. Support planning related to team structure, replacements, transfers, and future growth.

Skills & Experience Required

Management Experience Experience managing software engineering teams. Strong people-management and coaching skills. Experience conducting 1:1s, performance reviews, development discussions, and difficult conversations. Ability to identify performance and motivation issues and take appropriate action. Strong conflict-management and problem-solving skills.

Outsourcing / IT Services Experience Previous experience working in an IT outsourcing, consulting, nearshore, or software services company is highly preferred. Understanding of the relationship between the client, outsourcing company, and engineers assigned to the client project . Experience balancing client expectations with company and employee interests. Understanding of common outsourcing challenges, including staffing, retention, performance management, replacements, rate discussions, and client satisfaction. Ability to act as a trusted intermediary when disagreements or conflicts arise between the client and the company.

Stakeholder Management Strong stakeholder-management and relationship-building skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Experience working with international clients and distributed teams. Ability to manage expectations, negotiate priorities, and handle sensitive situations professionally. Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.

Business Development Commercial mindset and interest in developing existing client accounts. Ability to recognize new business and team-growth opportunities. Ability to understand client business needs beyond the immediate engineering scope. Experience participating in account-growth, staffing, or client-development discussions is preferred. Ability to build trusted relationships that can lead to long-term cooperation and account expansion.

Recruitment & Staffing Understanding of the software engineering recruitment process. Ability to define hiring needs together with technical and client stakeholders. Experience interviewing or evaluating candidates is preferred. Understanding of the Brazilian engineering talent market is an advantage.

Communication & Personal Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong ownership and proactive mindset. Ability to work independently and make decisions. Strong organizational and prioritization skills. Ability to manage several people-related, client-related, and operational topics simultaneously. High emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively in challenging or sensitive situations. Ability to communicate bad news, risks, or disagreements clearly and constructively.

Language & International Environment Strong professional English is required for communication with international clients and internal stakeholders. Experience working in multicultural and distributed environments is preferred.

title: Global sales support specialist (contractor)
description:
Role Description

The Global Sales Support Specialist (GSS) is a critical driver of revenue within the Sales Finance organization, empowering the Field Sales Team with expert support in complex quoting, order processing, and product configuration. As a subject matter expert, the GSS ensures seamless deal execution while collaborating across functions to streamline processes and maximize efficiency.

This fast-paced role demands a proactive, highly organized individual who thrives under pressure. The GSS directly engages with internal sales and business operations teams to optimize sales execution, enable new product introductions, and keep quoting operations running smoothly and effectively.

Location - Sao Paulo - HYBRID/ 3 days in office or 70% in office throughout the month Duration - 12 months

Your Impact

This position calls for someone who possesses good communication skills, sense of ownership, proactiveness and maturity working with confidential and sensitive information. This person is a self-starter, flexible, has a high level of integrity and quick to action in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment.

Sales Support Excellence: Support the Field Sales Team with quoting complex deals, responding to order inquiries, and providing guidance on product configurations in SFDC CPQ. Facilitate training on quote-to-order processes, including SFDC quoting sessions, ensuring that our Sales team members are equipped with the knowledge needed to drive sales success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams including Deal Review, Pricing, Product, Sales Operations, and IT to ensure the smooth implementation of business policies, scalable quoting processes, and GTM offerings in SFDC CPQ.

Process Documentation & Best Practices: Collaborate with the documentation team to ensure that our quoting decks are accurate, well-structured, and aligned to drive sales success. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in new product introductions, helping to design and refine quoting best practices for both new and existing products, ensuring clarity and consistency across all enablement materials.

System & Process Improvement: Serve as a key partner in driving business requirements for system enhancements in SFDC CPQ, actively participating in the testing and UAT process to ensure new functionalities align with business needs. Identify and escalate system gaps or opportunities for process improvements, collaborating to streamline workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.

GTM Readiness & Operational Coordination: Ensure the operational readiness of new GTM offers by collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable seamless execution of new product offerings. Build strong relationships with internal teams (Product, Sales, Legal, IT, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth quoting processes.

Project Management & Communication: Work with business partners to define objectives, set timelines, and track the status of quoting changes. Communicate milestones, dependencies, and project status updates to key stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.

Prioritization & Execution: Manage a shared mailbox for Global Sales Support activities, prioritizing requests based on revenue impact, customer relationship considerations, and timing requirements to meet deadlines.

Your Experience

Experience: 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or Contract Management, preferably in a Saa S or subscription-based business. Proven experience with Pricing/Quoting processes and an understanding of GTM strategies.

Technical Proficiency: Strong experience with Salesforce (SFDC CPQ) and proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.) is essential. A tech-savvy mindset and ability to navigate complex systems to enhance quoting processes.

Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and International stakeholders. Ability to balance individual tasks while supporting team priorities in a dynamic environment.

Organizational & Analytical Skills: Extremely detail-oriented with a high level of organization and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze processes and suggest improvements.

Additional Requirements: Ability to work extended hours as needed, particularly around month-end or quarter-end workloads. Flexibility to work alternate shifts to accommodate global requests and ensure timely support. Language: Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese.

Information about Palo Alto Networks

At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish — but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

title: Assistente jurídico b2b com 2 anos de experiência em grandes escritórios
description:
About us

Jumpstart Immigration provides a safer, more reliable path for global founders and skilled professionals seeking U. S. residency or work visas. We simplify complex immigration processes by combining high-level legal expertise with statistical models and artificial intelligence.

Through our exclusive Founders Package, we support a holistic transition to the U. S., encompassing immigration strategy, company formation partnerships, tax planning, and relocation services. We are a strategic partner for high-talent visa and Green Card categories, including O-1, EB-1 A, EB-2 NIW, E-2, L-1, and H-1 B.

Website:

Role description

We are looking for an Immigration Paralegal to help turn our clients’ professional achievements into well-documented, compelling immigration petitions.

Working closely with our attorneys and operations team, you will support case preparation from document review through final petition assembly, ensuring each case is accurate, consistent, and ready for attorney review on schedule.

This role requires excellent English writing skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple cases in a fast-paced environment. All substantive legal work will be performed under attorney supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Evidence Review and Organization: Review client documents, identify missing information or inconsistencies, and organize supporting evidence according to the attorney-defined case strategy. Drafting: Prepare drafts of petition support letters, recommendation letters, professional background summaries, and other supporting materials for attorney review. Research: Conduct factual and legal research under attorney direction to support case development and document clients’ achievements. Petition Assembly and Quality Control: Compile exhibits, prepare indexes, and cross-check names, dates, citations, translations, and supporting documents before final attorney review. Deadline Management: Track drafting milestones, filing deadlines, and attorney review cycles across multiple active cases. Post-Filing Support: Assist attorneys with responses to Requests for Evidence (RFEs) and other case-related requests. Process Improvement: Help improve templates, checklists, and workflows, using technology and AI tools responsibly while protecting confidential information and verifying outputs.

Qualifications

Relevant Experience: Previous experience as a paralegal or legal assistant. Advanced/Fluent English: Excellent written English and the ability to communicate clearly with international clients and team members are essential. Writing and Research Skills: Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, accurate, and well-supported drafts. Attention to Detail: Ability to identify inconsistencies across forms, supporting documents, and written narratives. Case Management: Experience handling multiple matters, maintaining organized records, and meeting deadlines. Technology Proficiency: Comfortable working with document management systems, collaborative tools, and AI-assisted workflows. Education: A degree in Law, paralegal training, or a related field is a plus.

The Ideal Profile

Organized and Accountable: You take ownership of deliverables, keep case files structured, and flag risks before they affect deadlines. Analytical: You connect evidence to the case strategy and recognize when additional documentation or attorney guidance is needed. A Strong Writer: You produce clear, precise drafts grounded in the client’s records. Collaborative: You work effectively with attorneys and operations colleagues and incorporate feedback quickly. Proactive: You anticipate next steps and move cases forward with appropriate supervision. Discreet and Professional: You handle sensitive personal and business information with care.

Location & Compensation

This is a fully remote position, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere. The role involves occasional in-person meetups for strategic planning and team building.

Compensation: R$ 8.000,00 per month (PJ) Workload: Full-time Start date: Immediately

title: Fiat operations specialist
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Mission

As a Fiat Operations Specialist, you will be responsible for driving the integration of local payment methods that allow users to deposit and withdraw BRL. You will collaborate closely with product, compliance, and tech teams to improve the fiat on&off-ramp experience for users. A key aspect of this role is working with the product team to identify opportunities to build the smooth user experience, ensuring that payment flows are intuitive, seamless, and aligned with customer and regulatory needs.

Key Responsibilities Own and manage BRL on/off-ramp channels end-to-end, ensuring availability, performance, and reliability. Serve as the primary point of contact for brazilian banks and payment vendors, payment service providers (PSPs), card processors, and other fiat partners, managing relationships, negotiations, and day-to-day communication to ensure reliable and efficient payment channels. Lead and coordinate technical integrations with local banks and payment gateways, working alongside engineering and product teams to ensure seamless implementation and ongoing maintenance of payment infrastructure; Ensure seamless user access to fiat products, minimizing friction in deposits and withdrawals. Monitor and manage the end-to-end operational process for fiat on&off-ramps, ensuring smooth transactions and rapid issue resolution for users. Identify emerging trends in user preferences, and regulatory changes in Brazil to adapt our platform accordingly. Work closely with Customer Support to resolve user issues related to deposits, withdrawals, and transaction status, including handling workflows and tickets raised by the CS team that are related to fiat operations. Maintain strong relationships with banking partners, payment service providers (PSPs), card processors, and other fiat partners. Ensure liquidity and operational stability of BRL fiat flows and payment channels. Use data and metrics to optimize payment integrations, minimize friction for users, and enhance the overall user experience; Work closely with the product team to improve the overall user experience of fiat on&off-ramp processes. Provide insights and feedback based on user behavior, transaction data, and customer feedback to inform product enhancements that improve payment flow, reduce friction, and increase user satisfaction. Support fiat on/off-ramp operations for additional currencies (e.g., ARS and others), as applicable. Monitor daily fiat operations, ensuring accurate processing, timely settlements, and proper reconciliation between internal systems and external partners. Coordinate card and payment infrastructure partners for Brazilian users, ensuring smooth operation of payment flows, supporting issue resolution and complaints handling, and actively participating in the design and improvement of these processes. Maintain and improve operational controls (limits, reconciliation routines, cut-off times, monitoring alerts). Identify, investigate, and resolve operational incidents, ensuring proper escalation and root cause analysis. Keep SOPs, runbooks, and operational documentation up to date and aligned with actual processes. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams to improve fiat infrastructure and processes. Act as a key advocate for the user experience, ensuring that payment-related touchpoints are designed to be intuitive, frictionless, and aligned with user needs and expectations.

Requirements Experience: 3+ years of experience in payment operations, banking, fintech in Brazil. Payments& Banking Background: Demonstrated experience in the payments or banking industry, with a strong understanding of the brazilian financial ecosystem, local payment rails, and banking operations; Technical Integration Experience: Hands-on experience coordinating technical integrations with banks, payment providers; ability to bridge communication between technical and business teams. Regulatory Awareness: Familiarity with brazilian financial regulations, anti-money laundering practices, KYCcompliance, and payment industry standards. Project Management: Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Problem Solving: Analytical thinker with a proactive approach to identifying issues and implementing effective solutions. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and liaise with internal and external stakeholders including banks and vendors. Languages: Fluency in both English and Portuguese is required (written and verbal). Additional languages are a plus.

Why Join Us

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.

- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.

- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.

- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Gerente de relacionamento pleno
description:

Diferenciais Experiência com gestão de benefícios corporativos de médio e grande porte; Conhecimento das principais operadoras e seguradoras de Saúde e Odonto; Experiência com análise de sinistralidade e estratégias de renovação; Vivência em negociação de reajustes e retenção de clientes; Experiência com gestão de equipes; Conhecimento de ferramentas/CRM para gestão de relacionamento e carteira.

title: Customer care analyst
description:

title: Business strategy specialist
description:
About us

Keeta is a global technology company on a mission to help people eat better and live better. As part of one of the world's leading technology groups, we operate food delivery and marketplace platforms that connect millions of customers, merchants, and riders every day. We are building the future of food delivery — combining cutting-edge technology, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to customer experience.

The Role

The Strategy & Operations team is responsible for driving operational performance and strategic decision-making across Business, Consumer, and Delivery functions.

In this role, you will monitor business indicators, identify improvement opportunities, and translate data into actionable strategies that support sustainable growth. Working closely with Operations, Product, Marketing, and Commercial stakeholders, you will help shape the direction of key business initiatives and ensure alignment with company objectives.

What You'll Do Monitor operational KPIs across business pillars, including merchant activation, customer retention, delivery SLAs, and cost efficiency, to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Develop dashboards, performance reports, and business analyses that provide leadership with clear visibility into operational health. Analyze customer, merchant, rider, and operational data to identify performance gaps and recommend actions that improve efficiency and business results. Partner with cross-functional teams to implement strategic initiatives and track execution progress against business objectives. Collaborate with Operations, Product, Marketing, and Commercial teams to drive continuous improvement and support business growth.

What We're Looking For Experience in Business Strategy, Performance Management, Business Intelligence, or Strategy Operations. Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, dashboards, and data visualization tools. Experience defining and monitoring operational KPIs and business performance metrics. Ability to transform data into actionable business recommendations. Data-driven professional with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Curious and proactive in identifying opportunities to improve business performance. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities. Strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills. Advanced English proficiency. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or related fields. Availability to work on-site in São Paulo.

Preferred Qualifications Experience in technology, marketplaces, logistics, or food delivery companies. Certifications in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, SQL, or Project Management. Mandarin proficiency is a plus.

What We Offer International and collaborative work environment. High ownership and autonomy. Opportunity to work on complex business challenges at scale. Career growth in one of the world's leading technology companies. Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Benefits Meal and food allowance (Caju Card) Transportation allowance Health and dental insurance Life insurance Childcare assistance

How to Apply

If you're excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply through Linked In and submit your resume in English.

By applying, you acknowledge that your information will be processed securely and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates as part of the recruitment process.

title: Arquiteto de dados
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting está com uma oportunidade imediata para Arquiteto(a) de Dados GCP experiente, com forte conhecimento técnico e verdadeira paixão por resolução de problemas complexos através da tecnologia. O profissional fará parte de um projeto estratégico com foco na revisão e otimização da arquitetura de dados em Google Cloud Platform, buscando aumento de eficiência, escalabilidade, governança e redução significativa dos custos de processamento em Big Query.

Buscamos um perfil sênior, consultivo e hands-on, capaz de atuar desde a definição e revisão da arquitetura até a implementação das melhorias necessárias no ambiente.

Perfil técnico: Sólida experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e Big Query , atuando em ambientes corporativos de dados de grande volume; Experiência em arquitetura, otimização e sustentação de plataformas de dados em cloud; Conhecimento avançado de arquitetura de Data Lake, incluindo organização e otimização das camadas Raw, Sub-Raw, Silver, Gold e Platinum; Experiência no desenho de estratégias de processamento incremental, evitando reprocessamentos e leituras desnecessárias de grandes volumes de dados; Conhecimento avançado de otimização de tabelas no Big Query, incluindo particionamento, clustering, cargas incrementais e otimização de queries; Experiência em análise de performance e custos de processamento no Big Query; Conhecimento de estratégias para tratamento e processamento de tabelas SAP de grande volume; Experiência com integração e ingestão de dados provenientes de ambientes como SAP e Salesforce; Conhecimento de ferramentas e tecnologias de integração como Airbyte, Apache Airflow, DAGs e CDC – Change Data Capture; Capacidade de revisar pipelines de ingestão e processamento de dados, identificando oportunidades de melhoria de performance e redução de custos; Conhecimento de arquitetura de dados transacional e analítica, incluindo definição adequada de workloads para cada tipo de processamento; Capacidade de avaliar alternativas tecnológicas, incluindo utilização de bancos como Postgre SQL para workloads transacionais e atualizações operacionais frequentes; Experiência com práticas de Fin Ops aplicadas a dados e cloud, incluindo análise de baseline de consumo, monitoramento de custos e identificação de oportunidades de otimização; Capacidade de estruturar mecanismos de acompanhamento da economia obtida através das otimizações implementadas; Conhecimento de modelos de alocação e visibilidade de custos por área, domínio, projeto ou unidade de negócio; Experiência com governança de ambientes Big Query, incluindo organização de projetos por domínio ou área de negócio; Conhecimento de IAM, permissões, grupos de acesso e estratégias de consumo cross-project dentro do GCP; Capacidade de analisar criticamente decisões arquiteturais existentes e propor alternativas tecnicamente sustentáveis e economicamente eficientes; Experiência prática em troubleshooting, produção e sustentação de ambientes de dados críticos; Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de implementar diretamente soluções e otimizações propostas.

Atuação: Atuar na revisão da arquitetura atual de dados em GCP e Big Query, identificando oportunidades de redução de processamento e consumo; Estabelecer baseline técnico e financeiro do ambiente atual para acompanhamento dos ganhos obtidos; Trabalhar com meta indicativa de redução entre 50% e 60% dos custos de processamento, condicionada às oportunidades identificadas durante a análise técnica do ambiente; Revisar arquitetura, modelagem, pipelines, tabelas, queries e estratégias de processamento atualmente utilizadas; Definir e implementar estratégias de processamento incremental e otimização das diferentes camadas do Data Lake; Revisar workloads transacionais e analíticos, recomendando a arquitetura mais adequada para cada cenário; Apoiar a evolução da governança do Big Query, incluindo estrutura de projetos, domínios, permissões e consumo entre projetos; Estruturar indicadores para acompanhamento de consumo, performance e economia gerada pelas iniciativas de otimização; Atuar de forma consultiva junto às equipes técnicas, questionando decisões arquiteturais e propondo soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas de arquitetura, performance e Fin Ops; Participar diretamente da implementação, validação, produção e sustentação das melhorias propostas; Atuação em projeto estratégico de otimização e evolução de plataforma de dados em ambiente corporativo de grande escala.

title: Licensed aircraft maintenance engineer b1/b2
description:
International opportunity | Relocation to Israel

We are helping our client recruit experienced B1 and B2 Licensed Aircraft Engineers for a long-term opportunity in Israel. The role offers the chance to work across a broad Boeing and Airbus fleet, combining hands-on line and base maintenance with responsibility for troubleshooting, aircraft serviceability and release.

The company welcomes engineers holding a B1 licence, B2 licence, or both , and provides visa and relocation support for international candidates moving to Israel.

What You'll Do

Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance across Boeing and Airbus aircraft. Take ownership of troubleshooting, fault diagnosis and defect rectification within your licence scope. Complete and certify maintenance work in accordance with your licence privileges, regulatory requirements and company procedures. Work across line and/or base maintenance, supporting safe and timely aircraft release. Maintain accurate technical records while coordinating with operations, planning and logistics teams.

What We're Looking For

A valid EASA Part-66 B1 and/or B2 licence . 5+ years of hands-on aircraft maintenance experience. Experience working with 2+ aircraft types from the following list: B737 NG, B737 MAX, A320 CEO, A320 NEO, B777 (GE), A300-600 (all engines). For B2 licence holders: B737 MAX type rating and 2+ years of hands-on B737 NG/MAX experience. For B2 licence holders: current Human Factors, EWIS and Fuel Tank Safety training. Fluent English language level.

Additional aircraft type experience and a B2 licence for B1 candidates are advantages.

Working Arrangements

title: Senior soc architect - remote
description:
Senior So C Architect

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced System-on-Chip (So C) Architect to drive the definition and development of next-generation semiconductor solutions. The ideal candidate will lead architectural decisions from product conception through silicon realization, working closely with product management, design, verification, software, validation, and customer teams.

This role requires a strong technical leader capable of translating market requirements into scalable and innovative So C architectures that meet performance, power, area, cost, safety, security, and schedule objectives.

Key Responsibilities: Define end-to-end So C architecture for complex semiconductor products. Drive architectural tradeoff analysis involving performance, power, area (PPA), cost, and risk. Define subsystem interfaces, interconnect architecture, memory hierarchy, and data flow. Lead IP selection, reuse, and integration strategies. Collaborate with design, verification, physical implementation, DFT, safety, security, and software teams. Drive performance analysis, and architectural validation. Support silicon bring-up, debugging, and product qualification activities. Mentor engineering teams and provide technical leadership across multiple projects.

Required Technical Skills:

Architecture & System Design:

Strong understanding of So C architecture principles. Experience defining heterogeneous multi-core architectures. Expertise in CPU, GPU, DSP, AI/ML accelerator, and embedded processor integration. Deep knowledge of memory architectures, cache coherency, and interconnect fabrics. Experience with No C (Network-on-Chip) architectures. Understanding of hardware-software co-design methodologies.

Semiconductor Design:

Solid background in RTL design and digital IC development. Understanding of ASIC and FPGA development flows. Knowledge of synthesis, timing closure, power optimization, and physical design constraints. Familiarity with advanced process nodes and design tradeoffs.

Verification & Modeling:

Experience with architectural modeling and simulation. Familiarity with UVM-based verification methodologies. Ability to define architectural test strategies and performance validation plans.

Interfaces & Standards:

Experience with several of the following:

AMBA AXI/AHB/APB PCIe Ethernet USB MIPI DDR/LPDDR UCIe CXL Coherent Interconnect protocols

Safety & Security:

Understanding of functional safety concepts (ISO 26262 preferred). Knowledge of secure boot, root of trust, cryptographic accelerators, and security architectures. Experience with automotive, industrial, aerospace, mobile, AI, or data-center applications is a plus.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph D in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 1015+ years of semiconductor industry experience. 5+ years in architecture or technical leadership roles. Proven track record delivering complex So Cs to production. Experience leading cross-functional global engineering teams.

title: Strategy operations sr. manager
description:
About the Role

As a Strategy & Operations Sr. Manager , you will sit at the intersection of finance, pricing, and commercial strategy — shaping how we win in international markets. Your financial expertise will directly influence our international expansion and revenue growth.

This is a role with real strategic impact: you will own the analytical engine behind our quotation and pricing decisions, translating market intelligence, competitive dynamics, and P& L structures into pricing strategies that balance profitability with market competitiveness. You will work closely with account managers, finance teams, and cross-cultural partners in a fast-growing international environment.

Beyond the analysis, you will build the playbook: developing quotation guidelines, approval workflows, and best practices that scale with the business — while growing deep expertise in international pricing strategy and commercial operations along the way.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & P& L Management

Analyze profit and loss structures across markets, products, and service models to understand cost drivers and margin opportunities. Build comprehensive financial models incorporating variable costs, fixed costs, market dynamics, and competitive positioning. Conduct scenario analysis and sensitivity testing to evaluate the impact of different pricing strategies on overall profitability.

Quotation Development & Optimization

Develop accurate and competitive quotation proposals based on financial analysis, market research, and business objectives. Collaborate with account managers to gather client requirements, market conditions, and competitive intelligence for quotation preparation. Continuously optimize quotation templates and processes to improve efficiency and accuracy while maintaining compliance.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

Monitor market pricing trends, competitor strategies, and industry dynamics to inform quotation decisions. Analyze historical quotation performance and win/loss rates to identify optimization opportunities. Provide regular market intelligence reports to support strategic pricing decisions.

Process Improvement & Best Practices

Develop and maintain quotation guidelines, templates, and approval workflows to ensure consistency and compliance. Identify opportunities to streamline quotation processes and improve turnaround times. Train and support account managers on financial analysis and quotation best practices.

Job Requirements 8+ years of experience in financial analysis, pricing, or commercial operations, preferably in cross-border e-commerce or platform businesses. Strong financial modeling skills, with advanced proficiency in financial analysis tools. Excellent English proficiency (written and verbal) for international communication and documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy. Collaborative and customer-centric mindset, with the ability to work effectively across functions and with external partners.

Preferred Qualifications Experience in food delivery, e-commerce, or on-demand platform businesses where pricing strategy is critical for market success. Background in commercial operations, pricing strategy, or financial planning & analysis (FP& A). Strong business acumen, with the ability to balance financial objectives with market competitiveness. Experience with data analysis tools for market and performance analysis.

title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English

Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Elementary school counselor
description:
Welcome to Pan American

Pan American - the International School of Porto Alegre is an American-International school serving students from Preschool age 3 through Grade 12. Multicultural in nature, we are the only school in Porto Alegre offering international diplomas in addition to the Brazilian diploma. With a focus on academic excellence and teaching quality, we are Porto Alegre's leading education provider. Our smaller size allows us to offer personalized yet challenging educational experiences for all of our students.

Elementary School Counselor

• The Elementary School Counselor provides a comprehensive counseling program supporting the academic, social, and emotional development of students in Grades 1 through 5. The counselor collaborates with students, families, teachers, and leadership to promote well-being, positive relationships, and a safe, inclusive school climate. The position serves as a core member of the Elementary Student Support Services team.

Mandatory Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology;

• Master's Degree in School Counseling, Psychology, or a related field (preferred);

• Fluent in English with fluency in Portuguese;

• Minimum of three (3) years of experience working with children in school settings;

• Deep knowledge of childhood social, emotional, cognitive, and behavioral development, as well as evidence-based counseling practices;

• Skills in delivering social-emotional learning (SEL), conflict resolution, and restorative practices.

Working Hours

• 40 hours per week - Monday to Friday from m 7:45 a.m. to 4:45 p.m.

Benefits

• Unimax health plan;

• Dental plan (with monthly fee);

• Childcare assistance;

• Morning snack;

• On-site lunch;

• Life insurance;

• Transportation voucher.
